messages:
Jordan: Quick heads-up — planning to onboard model `northstar-7b` to the catalog today in the 18:00 UTC slot. Who can own the deploy and smoke run?
Maya: I can take deploy + canary checks. ETA 18:00 UTC works for me. :+1:
Sam: I can do rollback readiness and watch metrics. I'll have a rollback alias ready: `catalog rollback northstar-7b --to v1`
Liam: I'll run short perf smoke after canary (latency p50/p95). Where do you want traces sent?
Jordan: Send traces to `channels=eng-ml,eng-sre` and post the perf summary in this thread.
Maya: Quick checklist before deploy:
- confirm model artefact in registry (sha present)
- pin manifest updated in staging -> prod mapping
- autoscaler policy reviewed
- QA smoke prompt set (small eval)
Sam: Artefact: sha 9f3a2b validated in registry. Pin manifest patch ready at `git rev: 8c2e`
Maya: Deploy commands (will run from staging node):
```bash
# promote artifact and pin
./catalogctl promote --model northstar-7b --from staging --to prod --version v2
./catalogctl pin --model northstar-7b --version v2 --owner @Maya
```
Maya: Running canary now (starting 18:01 UTC). Will post smoke logs.
qa-bot: smoke-results: 3 tests failed, 42 passed. Failing tests are unrelated to core generation (tokenizer edgecases). Report: https://ci.example/reports/3512345678
Sam: Noted — I can triage tokenizer fuzz after rollout. For rollback: if latency >200ms p95 or error rate >0.5% for 5m, we rollback. Agreed?
Jordan: Agreed. Also keep an eye on cost spike — routing policy may need to shift to smaller variant if burst.
Liam: Canary perf: p50 38ms, p95 172ms, error 0.12%. All green. Posting traces to eng-sre with tag `northstar-7b/canary`
Maya: Canary complete, promoting to full after 10m stable window.
Sam: I've staged rollback alias `northstar-7b-rollback -> northstar-7b:v1` in case.
Maya: Full promote done. Pin manifest merged in `main` (PR: https://git.internal/pr/4321).
qa-bot: post-deploy-eval: 100 prompts sampled, quality delta vs v1: -0.6% BLEU (within tolerance).
Jordan: Nice. Closing loop: Sam for rollback, Liam for perf watch, Maya owner of manifest. I'll update the catalog release note and the ops calendar. Thanks all :rocket:
Maya: leaving a short runbook in the repo under `docs/onboarding/northstar-7b.md` with smoke commands and rollback steps.
Sam: LGTM.
Liam: :thumbsup:
Jordan: thread archived after 1h if no follow-ups.
